props.name: children
props.description: The panes, anywhere below. Only `ScrollSyncPane`s take part.

props.name: mode
props.description: `proportional` matches how far through each pane is. `anchor` lines up elements that share a `data-sync-anchor` value and interpolates between them.

props.name: axis
props.description: Which scroll direction to keep in step.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Turn syncing off without unmounting anything.
